name: microsoft-teams-mcp
description: Microsoft Teams for Claude — read your chats, teams, channels, and their currently open messages, via your browser

tools.name: teams_list_chats
tools.description: List the chats in the signed-in user's Teams chat sidebar

tools.name: teams_get_open_chat_messages
tools.description: Read the message thread of whichever Teams chat is currently open

tools.name: teams_list_teams_and_channels
tools.description: List the Teams the signed-in user belongs to and their channels

tools.name: teams_get_open_channel_posts
tools.description: Read the top-level posts of whichever Teams channel is currently open

tools.name: teams_get_activity
tools.description: Read the Activity feed — mentions, replies, and reactions across every chat and channel

tools.name: teams_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the browser bridge can reach a signed-in Teams tab
